programs.description: Ashwathi, a lower-middle-class Malayali woman, comes to Saudi Arabia as a migrant worker. Unable to deal with torture at the workplace, she attempts to flee the country.
Susheela deserts her children and husband, Kaimal, to begin a new life with Giri. On learning this, Kaimal's friend, Balan, tries to reconcile them.
When village boy Gopikrishnan goes to study in a city college, he is bullied by his classmates. Namitha supports him through his difficult phase and they develop a close bond.
Usha, a foreign-returned woman, falls in love with Balan, a poor school teacher. However, her family opposes their union and wants her to marry her cousin Thampi.
To take his mind off of his dead lover, Ananthan accepts the position of a college professor. Soon, his life changes for the better and he finds solace in Sridevi's company.
Although married, Vishnu is a habitual flirt and always looks out for an affair. When he is almost caught with a young girl in his house, he lies to his family that she is his illegitimate daughter.
Two brothers are constantly at odds over continuing their family legacy. Eventually, their rivalry reaches extreme proportions, threatening to destroy the bond of brotherhood.
Sreenivasan, a simple villager, is passionate about local theatre and hanging out with his friends. His life takes a turn when he applies for a job in the police department.
Vijay's life takes an unexpected turn when he falls for Merin. However, he is already betrothed to Pavithra, the daughter of an affluent man.
Susheela deserts her children and husband, Kaimal, to begin a new life with Giri. On learning this, Kaimal's friend, Balan, tries to reconcile them.
Madhavan is loved and respected by everyone in the village except his brothers who hate him. Matters get worse after his brothers try to falsely implicate him in an acquaintance's murder case.
Religious intolerance in a small faction results in a communal riot. A Muslim father is torn apart when his daughter requests him to marry her off to her Hindu lover.
Vimala and her three sisters run a theatre called Maharaja Talkies. They get in trouble when Pappachan, a rich man, forces Vimala to shut down the theatre.
Sam, a football player, gets admission in a prestigious international school under sports quota. His life changes for the better when he falls in love with a girl from the same school.
Conflicts arise between the heir to a wealthy rural family and his overprotective father. However, hilarity ensues after the heir runs away to the city and gets involved in a series of mishaps.
Friends Kochu Kurup and Aniyankutty fall for the same girl, Padmaja. When Aniyankutty discovers that she loves his friend, he plans to sabotage their relationship, resulting in hilarious events.
A musically gifted man pretending to be a priest wins hearts in a royal household, but buried family secrets and a long-lost connection soon stir tension beneath the festivities.
Two bumbling brothers fall madly in love with a young female employee. However, hilarity ensues after they realise the woman nurtures a secret agenda.
